verdict.rationale: PagerDuty publishes official OpenAPI v3 definitions of its public APIs in the PagerDuty/api-schema GitHub repo. Its developer docs give a direct raw URL to openapiv3.json for importing into OpenAPI tools such as Postman. An interactive OpenAPI reference also covers the REST, Events, SCIM and other APIs. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration that the downloaded spec is complete and accurate.
